about: Composition engines for app screens. An engine is not a look: it is how something that belongs to the product's world becomes the device the screen is built on. `kinetic deal` deals engines; the model chooses among them and fuses one with its inventory. Geometry is for a 393x852pt phone (iOS: content starts at y=59 under the status bar, home indicator band 818-852); scale bands proportionally on Android (412x915dp, top inset 24-48).

engines.name: Verdict sentence
engines.device: a display-size sentence that answers the glance question in the product's voice, with the number as proof underneath
engines.shell: native navigation untouched; compact contextual header instead of a large title
first_viewport: 59-103 context line: place / subject + data age, 15/20 text-2
103-251 verdict: 34-44pt display, 2 lines max, sentence case, the answer first
251-307 proof: the number + its basis ('62 left - usually gone by 15:00'), tabular 17/22
307-371 one drawn vocabulary object at 48-64pt beside or under the proof, carrying state
371-818 the next decision (one list or one action group); primary action in the thumb band 730-818
engines.signature_move: the sentence changes tense and wording with state and data age ('Was quiet at 11:40.') instead of a stale badge
engines.live_thing: pull down to re-ask: the sentence rewrites itself word by word when fresh data lands
risks: D31 if the sentence hides the number
copy that sells instead of answers

engines.name: The object is the control
engines.device: the product's real-world object, drawn large, is the primary input: you act on its parts instead of on a form
engines.shell: native navigation; the object replaces the form, not the nav
first_viewport: 59-115 title of the object + its current state, 17/22 semibold
115-555 the drawn object, 280-440pt tall, every interactive part >= 44pt with a visible boundary
555-640 readout of what the touched part means, 20/26
640-818 confirm action docked in the thumb band; secondary as text button
engines.signature_move: parts of the object light, fill or mark as you act on them; the object is also the receipt
engines.live_thing: drag or tap directly on the object with haptic detents; a list fallback for VoiceOver/TalkBack
risks: F05 small parts
F07 unlabeled parts
needs a non-visual equivalent

engines.name: The ledger
engines.device: entries typeset like a ledger or receipt: ruled lines, a running balance, totals that settle
engines.shell: native list behaviour (swipe actions, edit) with ledger typography
first_viewport: 59-171 the running position: 40-56pt tabular figure + one line of meaning
171-187 double rule (hairline + 2pt) = the ledger's identity
187-675 rows: date column, description, right-aligned tabular amount; 52-60pt rows, a hairline between rows only — never under each line of a row
675-818 add bar docked, or the closing total line
engines.signature_move: the settle moment: a total rule draws across and the balance line re-sets
engines.live_thing: swipe a row to settle it: the amount strikes through and slides into the total
risks: D04 if it grows tiles
F04 long descriptions

engines.name: The day as a spine
engines.device: a vertical time line is the screen's structure: now is a fixed marker, the past above, what's next below
engines.shell: native header and tabs; the spine is content
first_viewport: 59-131 now: one sentence or time + state at 28-34pt
131-818 spine at x=28-36: hour ticks 13/16 text-3, events as marks on the spine with 15-17pt labels; NOW marker pinned at ~y=320
future events in text-2 at half weight; past logged events with their own mark
engines.signature_move: the spine itself encodes state (solid where logged, dotted where not yet known)
engines.live_thing: scrub along the spine with the thumb; the now-sentence rewrites for the scrubbed time
risks: unknown shown as nothing happened (states.md 3c)
D31 legend for line styles

engines.name: Marks that count
engines.device: quantities shown as repeated marks of the domain (ticks, stamps, punches, beads) instead of numerals or charts
engines.shell: native
first_viewport: 59-151 question or verdict, 28-34pt
151-391 the tally field: marks at 20-28pt on a 4-column rhythm, grouped by 5 or by the domain's natural unit
391-447 the count in words + numeral, 17/22
447-818 entries or the action to add a mark (thumb band)
engines.signature_move: a new mark is drawn in the domain's gesture (a stroke, a stamp, a punch)
engines.live_thing: tap-and-hold the field to add a mark; the mark is drawn under the finger
risks: D31 if marks need a legend
counts > 30 need a numeral

engines.name: State as a colour field
engines.device: the top of the screen is one large field whose colour and words are the current state; one state, one field
engines.shell: native; the field sits under a transparent nav bar
first_viewport: 0-331 full-bleed field including the status bar area; state word or sentence 34-40pt on the field at y~200-300
331-387 what changed and when, 15/20
387-818 surface sheet rising over the field (radius 20-28 top corners) with the details
engines.signature_move: the field crossfades to the next state; nothing else on the screen repeats the state (D32)
engines.live_thing: drag the sheet down to give the field the whole screen (glanceable from a distance)
risks: contrast of text on each field
colour-only meaning: the word must carry it

engines.name: Time of day
engines.device: the ground and ink follow real time or real light, so the screen tells the hour before you read it
engines.shell: native
first_viewport: 59-251 the moment: sentence about now at 30-36pt over the time-tinted ground
251-307 the next change in time ('Light until 19:42')
307-818 content cards on surfaces that keep contrast across all tints
engines.signature_move: 4-6 designed grounds (dawn, day, dusk, night...) not a continuous gradient
engines.live_thing: scrub a small sun/moon mark to preview another hour
risks: contrast across every tint
dark mode must be designed per tint

engines.name: The plan
engines.device: a drawn plan, schematic or map of the place (floor, route, garden, shelf layout) is the home and the index
engines.shell: native header; plan is zoomable content with a list equivalent
first_viewport: 59-115 where you are / which zone, 17/22
115-515 the plan, drawn with the vocabulary's line weight; zones carry state by fill + word
515-818 the selected zone's detail as a sheet, or the list of zones
engines.signature_move: tap a zone: the plan lifts that zone and the sheet answers for it
engines.live_thing: pinch/drag the plan with snap-to-zone detents
risks: accessibility: every zone also in a list
map-first when the question is not spatial

engines.name: Specimen sheet
engines.device: the catalogue drawn like a field guide: every item in the same frame, scale and lighting, labelled like a specimen
engines.shell: native search + filter; the grid is content
first_viewport: 59-131 collection title + count, 22/28
131-818 grid: 2 columns of 168x210 or 3 of 110x140; each item drawn/photographed on the same ground, label 13/16 with its specimen number
engines.signature_move: uniform framing makes differences readable; selection opens the specimen card at full size
engines.live_thing: long-press a specimen to compare it with the last one viewed
risks: needs consistent assets
D04 if it becomes tiles of stats

engines.name: Borrowed artefact
engines.device: art-direct the screen as a printed artefact from the product's world (timetable, ticket, label, programme, prescription, menu, receipt)
fits: any product with a real printed artefact
misfits: products without one (then don't invent one)
engines.shell: native controls; the artefact's typography, rules and numbering carry the identity
first_viewport: 59-171 the artefact's header as it would be printed (issuer, number, date), set in its typographic tradition
171-675 the artefact's body: its columns, rules and numbering, holding live data
675-818 the one action, native
engines.signature_move: a detail only the real artefact has (perforation, stamp, punched hole, serial number) carries state
engines.live_thing: the artefact's own gesture: tear off, stamp, flip to the back
risks: costume if the artefact isn't from this product's world
skeuomorphic chrome on controls (keep controls native)

engines.name: One thing at a time
engines.device: one full-screen question or item per step; the next only appears when this one is answered
engines.shell: native nav bar with progress in words ('2 of 5')
first_viewport: 59-103 step in words, 13/16 text-2
103-371 the question, 28-34pt, up to 3 lines
371-675 the answers as large targets (64-80pt rows) or the object-control
675-818 continue / skip in the thumb band
engines.signature_move: the answer you give stays visible as a quiet line under the next question (a growing summary)
engines.live_thing: swipe the question card away to answer the most common way, with undo
risks: slow for repeat use: give an expert shortcut

engines.name: Instrument
engines.device: one physical-style instrument (gauge, scale, ruler, thermometer, level) as the hero, read exactly
engines.shell: native
first_viewport: 59-115 what is measured, 17/22
115-451 the instrument, 280-336pt, with graduations in text-3 and the reading as 40-56pt tabular text inside or under it
451-507 what the reading means, 17/22
507-818 next actions / history
engines.signature_move: graduations and the needle are the brand's line; the instrument settles with a damped spring
engines.live_thing: drag the needle to set a target; detents at meaningful values
risks: D04 ring clones: an instrument must be a real instrument of the domain, not a progress ring

engines.name: Ticket stack
engines.device: the items you hold (passes, bookings, orders) as a physical stack you thumb through, the next one on top
engines.shell: native; a list view is one tap away
first_viewport: 59-115 'Next' + time to it, 17/22
115-547 the top ticket at 345x420: issuer, the one fact you need at the door at 34-44pt, a perforation line
547-627 the edges of the next 2 tickets, offset 8-12pt
627-818 the ticket's action (show code, directions)
engines.signature_move: the perforation carries state (torn = used), the stub carries the code
engines.live_thing: flick the top ticket to the back of the stack; drag down to tear the stub
risks: F07 gestures without buttons
stack depth hidden from VoiceOver

engines.name: Field notebook
engines.device: entries written into a ruled notebook: dated, annotated in the margin, crossed out rather than deleted
engines.shell: native
first_viewport: 59-131 the page's date as the notebook writes it, 22/28
131-818 entries sit on a quiet ruled ground: a rule BETWEEN entries (not under every line), a 44-76pt margin column for times and marks, paragraphs with natural leading inside one entry
engines.signature_move: margin marks (tick, star, arrow) are the vocabulary; edits strike through and keep history
engines.live_thing: swipe right on an entry to add a margin mark
risks: ruling every line turns the page into stripes (clutter): rule between entries only
handwriting faces only for marks/annotations

engines.name: Score sheet
engines.device: a grid like a scorecard or attendance sheet: rows of subjects, columns of occasions, cells filled by marks
engines.shell: native; horizontal scroll of columns with a pinned first column
first_viewport: 59-131 the sheet's title + today's column highlighted, 22/28
131-651 grid: first column 120pt names, cells 44x44pt with the domain mark; today column in the accent field
651-818 the action for today's cell
engines.signature_move: today's column is a colour field; filled cells use the domain's mark, not a check-circle
engines.live_thing: tap a cell to cycle its mark with a detent haptic
risks: F04 at XXL: cells must grow; provide a list per row

engines.name: Pinned board
engines.device: a noticeboard: what matters is pinned higher and larger; notices age visibly
engines.shell: native
first_viewport: 59-115 the board's place + date, 17/22
115-395 the pinned notice: 22-28pt headline, author + time, pin mark
395-818 smaller notices in ONE column (or an aligned 2-up with equal tops and heights): age and priority show by size, pin and paper tone — never by offsets or rotation
engines.signature_move: age shows by paper fade and position, not a 'new' badge
engines.live_thing: drag a notice to pin it for yourself
risks: clutter: max 1 pinned + 4 visible
staggered or rotated cards read as misalignment, not a board

engines.name: Index by type
engines.device: huge type is the navigation: letters, numbers or names at display size form the index you scroll
engines.shell: native search; the index is the list
first_viewport: 59-115 search field (native)
115-818 index rows: 44-64pt display words, 0.95 line height, the current entry's detail in 15/20 under it
engines.signature_move: the display face is the brand; selection opens the entry where the word grows into its title
engines.live_thing: scrub the right edge to jump letters with selection haptics
risks: F04 long names at XXL: wrap, never ellipsis

engines.name: The shelf
engines.device: items stand on shelves like spines, jars or boxes whose physical state (height, fill, tilt) shows their status
engines.shell: native; a list equivalent exists
first_viewport: 59-131 shelf name + what needs you, 22/28
131-411 shelf 1: spines 28-44pt wide, 160-220pt tall, labels set vertically or on the base
691-818 the action for the selected item
engines.signature_move: an item that needs you leans out of the shelf
engines.live_thing: pull a spine out to open it
risks: vertical text legibility
accessibility list required

engines.name: The place speaks
engines.device: the product addresses you in short signed messages from real people of the place, instead of system banners
misfits: anything without real people behind it
engines.shell: native
first_viewport: 59-131 the place's name + who is on today, 17/22
131-371 the latest message as a 22-28pt quote with signature and time
371-818 what you can do about it, then earlier messages
engines.signature_move: every system state is said by a named person or the place itself, never 'Oops'
engines.live_thing: reply with one tap from the message (a short, prepared answer)
risks: F01 fabricated people: only real staff, labelled
chat-app costume

engines.name: Time left
engines.device: the time remaining before the thing that matters is the hero, drawn in the domain's way of counting
engines.shell: native; Live Activity / widget mirrors it
first_viewport: 59-115 what you are waiting for, 17/22
115-299 time left at 64-96pt tabular, unit in words
299-355 the condition ('if you leave by 08:12')
355-818 the alternatives in order of usefulness
engines.signature_move: the numeral's weight or width changes as time runs out (variable width/weight axis)
engines.live_thing: drag the condition to see the time left for a later choice
risks: stale numbers must look stale
D04 if it becomes a ring

engines.name: Layers
engines.device: horizontal bands stacked like strata, floors or depths; position = level, thickness = amount
engines.shell: native
first_viewport: 59-131 the total in a sentence, 22/28
131-651 bands full-width, height proportional (min 44pt), label + value inside each band
651-818 the selected band's detail or action
engines.signature_move: bands grow or shrink with a settling spring; your position is a marker line across them
engines.live_thing: drag a band edge to rebalance, with detents
risks: D31 if band colours need a legend: labels inside bands
